_source: Drafted from Wikipedia's '2026' article (Events section), read 15 Oct 2026. Edit freely: date (YYYY-MM-DD), kind (politics, science, sport, culture, world), headline, blurb. The voyage shows one event a month: the one marked "pick": true, or else the month's first.

events.headline: Bulgaria joins the euro
events.blurb: Bulgaria becomes the 21st member of the eurozone.

events.headline: US strikes Venezuela
events.blurb: US airstrikes end with the capture of President Nicolás Maduro.

events.headline: US leaves the WHO
events.blurb: The United States formally withdraws from the World Health Organization.

events.headline: First female Archbishop of Canterbury
events.blurb: Sarah Mullally takes office as Archbishop of Canterbury.

events.headline: Winter Olympics open
events.blurb: Milan and Cortina d'Ampezzo host the first Games officially shared by two cities.

events.headline: Takaichi's landslide
events.blurb: Japan's Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi wins a supermajority.

events.headline: War with Iran
events.blurb: US and Israeli strikes kill Supreme Leader Ali Khamenei, starting the 2026 Iran war.

events.headline: India win the T20 World Cup
events.blurb: India beat New Zealand in the final for a third title.

events.headline: OpenAI shuts down Sora
events.blurb: OpenAI announces its Sora video app and API are closing.

events.headline: Artemis II launches
events.blurb: The first crewed flight beyond low Earth orbit since Apollo 17 heads for the Moon.

events.headline: Furthest humans from Earth
events.blurb: Artemis II's crew reach 406,771 km from home, a new record.

events.headline: Orbán voted out
events.blurb: Péter Magyar's Tisza Party ends 16 years of Fidesz rule in Hungary.

events.headline: UAE leaves OPEC
events.blurb: The United Arab Emirates ends six decades of OPEC membership.

events.headline: Bulgaria wins Eurovision
events.blurb: Dara's 'Bangaranga' takes Bulgaria's first Eurovision win, in Vienna.

events.headline: Europe's record heatwave
events.blurb: Record-breaking heat begins across Europe and lasts for weeks.

events.headline: The World Cup kicks off
events.blurb: Canada, Mexico and the United States host the 48-team FIFA World Cup.

events.headline: SpaceX goes public
events.blurb: The IPO makes Elon Musk the first US-dollar trillionaire.

events.headline: The Islamabad Memorandum
events.blurb: The US and Iran sign a 14-point deal to end the war and reopen the Strait of Hormuz.

events.headline: Starmer resigns
events.blurb: Keir Starmer announces his resignation as UK Prime Minister.

events.headline: Australia win the Women's T20 World Cup
events.blurb: Australia take the title in England and Wales.

events.headline: A new mile world record
events.blurb: Josh Kerr runs 3:42.66 in London, breaking a record that stood since 1999.

events.headline: Spain win the World Cup
events.blurb: Spain beat Argentina 1–0 in extra time for their second world title.

events.headline: Andy Burnham becomes PM
events.blurb: Burnham succeeds Keir Starmer as Prime Minister of the United Kingdom.

events.headline: Commonwealth Games in Glasgow
events.blurb: The 2026 Commonwealth Games open in Scotland.

events.headline: Total solar eclipse over Europe
events.blurb: The first total eclipse seen from continental Europe since 1999.

events.headline: A new King of Norway
events.blurb: King Harald V dies and is succeeded by his son, King Haakon VIII.

events.headline: Roman Space Telescope launches
events.blurb: NASA's flagship observatory lifts off to study dark energy and exoplanets.

events.headline: A new species of cat
events.blurb: Bolivia's Leopardus tilcayo is the first new feline species identified since 1923.

events.headline: A Greenland agreement
events.blurb: Denmark, Greenland and the US agree to strengthen Arctic security.

events.headline: Asian Games in Aichi
events.blurb: Japan's Aichi Prefecture hosts the 2026 Asian Games.

events.headline: G7 releases oil reserves
events.blurb: Leaders release 100 million barrels as diesel prices hit records.

_eggs: Easter eggs: scenery moments on fixed dates, kept apart from the news so they show even if a news item goes. kind is one the page knows (fireworks, valentine, stpatrick, rocket, easter, eagle, eclipse, halloween, christmas); note is the small line shown as it happens. Each shows only if the voyage reaches its date.
